platforms.name: Telegram

stealth: Open the chat in the Telegram app on your Mac.
Drag the Polyphonia image into the chat, or attach it with the paperclip button.
In the send window, choose the option to send it as a file without compression.
Send. The recipient should see a file, not a photo preview.
robust: Open the chat in the Telegram app on your Mac.
Drag the Polyphonia image into the chat.
Send it as a normal photo (the compressed, quick option).

platforms.notes: Sending as a file keeps the original, up to 2 GB per file (4 GB with Premium). Photos sent the normal way are compressed and lose hidden data.

platforms.name: WhatsApp

stealth: Open the chat in WhatsApp on your Mac.
Click the attach button and choose Document.
Select the Polyphonia image and send it.
Do not use the Photos & Videos option: it compresses the image, even in HD.
robust: Open the chat in WhatsApp on your Mac.
Click the attach button and choose the photos option.
Select the Polyphonia image and send it as a normal photo.

platforms.notes: Documents keep the original file. The help center lists up to 2 GB from WhatsApp Desktop/Web; the Android page lists 100 MB. Normal and HD photos are both compressed.

platforms.name: Signal

stealth: Open the chat in Signal Desktop on your Mac.
Attach the Polyphonia image using the option to send it as a file or document, not as a photo.
Send. The recipient should see a file attachment, not a photo preview.
robust: Open the chat in Signal Desktop on your Mac.
Drag the Polyphonia image into the chat.
Send it as a normal photo.

platforms.notes: Files and documents skip compression, up to 100 MB. Normal photos are recompressed and shrunk (reported as about 1200x1600; not confirmed by an official source). How Signal Desktop decides between photo and file is not confirmed yet: check it in the real send test.

platforms.name: Discord

stealth: Open the channel or DM in the Discord app on your Mac.
Drag the Polyphonia image into the message box, or attach it with the upload button.
Send it. Use the desktop app, not mobile, which may compress images.
robust: Open the channel or DM in the Discord app.
Attach the Polyphonia image and send it.

platforms.notes: Uploaded files are generally kept as-is on desktop. The free upload limit is 20 MB (since August 2026; Nitro Basic 50 MB). The mobile apps may compress images before upload.

platforms.name: Instagram

stealth: Not available: Instagram direct messages have no file or document attachment, so a stealth image always gets compressed.
robust: Open the conversation in Instagram direct messages.
Attach the Polyphonia image from your files or photo library (don't take a new photo in the app).
If an HD option is offered, turn it on, then send.

platforms.notes: The consumer app has no file/document attachment. Photos are heavily compressed; the HD option is still compressed, just less.

platforms.name: Email

stealth: Create a new email in your mail app.
Attach the Polyphonia image as a file attachment.
In Apple Mail, check that the image size option in the message header is set to Actual Size, not a smaller size.
robust: Create a new email in your mail app.
Attach the Polyphonia image and send it.

platforms.notes: Attachments are delivered unchanged. Exception: some mail apps can shrink attached images before sending (Apple Mail has an image size option; Actual Size is the default). Large attachments may be replaced by a download link (e.g. Mail Drop), which still delivers the original file.

explain.stealth: Looks like a normal image. Holds the most, but it only arrives intact if you send it as a file or document, not as a photo.
explain.robust: Survives compression, so send it as a normal photo. It looks like abstract art and holds less.
